stats.title: Download statistics
stats.clearMessage: All statistics will be deleted. This cannot be undone. Your download list and files are not affected.
stats.savedNone: Appears after a few regular downloads finish
stats.dailyAria: {size} in {n} files over the last 30 days
stats.note: Statistics stay on this computer and are never uploaded; only the domain is stored, not the full URL. "Time saved" is an estimate: while downloading, PGet samples the speed of each connection, uses the average single-connection speed to estimate how long one connection would have taken, and subtracts the actual time. Video sites and BitTorrent/magnet downloads are not included in the estimate.
stats.emptyHint: Once downloads finish, this page shows how much you downloaded and how much time multi-connection saved you.
